name: TRON 2
specs_note: Owner approved 2026-11-11 (unpublished; publication is a separate decision). RETRIEVAL: HO-DATA new-robot scan 2026-11-09, first-party page https://www.limxdynamics.com/en/products/tron2 (robots.txt disallows only /api/ and /admin/). Page text: 'TRON 2 Multi-Form Embodied Robot'; 'Tri-Form New Configuration: Dual Arms, Wheeled Legs, Sole'; '7-DoF per Arm'; '10kg Dual-Arm Payload'; 'Up to 1.5 m working height'; 'bipedal body height'. The maker does NOT call it a humanoid. Owner view (2026-11-11): not a typical humanoid on its own, but arguably one when the parts are combined. Scope decision required (docs/16 §17.1). All spec fields null. Page also states: 'supporting embodied intelligence research in real-world scenarios'; 'Ready Out of the Box, Development Made Easy'.

use_case_fits.notes: Page states the TRON 2 Mobile Manipulation Kit supports embodied intelligence research in real-world scenarios. Manufacturer positioning only.
use_case_fits.limitations: No deployments or demonstrations are recorded; fit rests on the maker's stated scenarios only.
